messages.subject: gather vs melt
parts:
Dear all,

just getting familiar with tidyr and dplyr. Wanting to replace plyr and reshape2 for better readabilty and speed. I stumbled across:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/24880835/how-to-melt-and-cast-dataframes-using-dplyr

require(tidyr); library(reshape2); library(microbenchmark)
microbenchmark(
    melt = melt(iris,id.vars="Species"),
    gather_ = gather_(iris, "variable", "value", c("Sepal.Length","Sepal.Width","Petal.Length","Petal.Width")),
 gather = gather(iris, variable, value, -Species)
)

Gives:
> + + + + Unit: microseconds
    expr     min       lq     mean  median       uq      max neval cld
    melt 312.697 320.0555 349.7348 324.157 330.4155 2584.260   100  b
 gather_ 269.471 276.0895 285.5160 278.107 283.3680  491.978   100 a 
  gather 530.895 543.2130 556.2715 549.776 561.1800  714.492   100   c
 
Why is gather slower and gather_ faster than melt?

For programming, melt still seems superior i.e. less verbose. I like that the defaults are fine. I will rename "variable" in the plot. My 2 pence.
